title: シティコミューターバイク
description: ダイヤモンドフレーム、スポーク車輪、連続したリンクチェーン、クランク、ブレーキ、泥よけと荷台を備えた街乗り自転車。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 繰り返し部品は材質と構成単位ごとに統合済み。
descriptionEn: Unbranded commuter bicycle with diamond frame, cross-laced spokes, linked chain drive, cranks, pedals, rim brakes and cables, fenders, rear rack and lights. Static visualization assembly, not a rideable or engineering-validated design. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Repeated static details are grouped by material and assembly; the procedural source retains the editable construction.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.

provenance.tool: Blender 4.3.2; Meshcopia city generator 1.0; Meshcopia attribute-preserving static grouping 1.0
provenance.rights: Original geometry and material design created for Xenoah Meshcopia under the owner request for CC-BY-4.0 publication. No third-party meshes, scans, brands, logos or font files.

staticGrouping.positionOperation: translation baked to float32; validate roundoff bound
staticGrouping.normalUvMaterialOperation: source float values/material JSON preserved; no normal recomputation

provenance.changes: Repeated static details grouped by material and named assembly with original triangle-corner normals, UVs and material records preserved; no geometry simplification. Baseline GLB SHA-256: 9206cdf69ddbbf3d41f17da59fb848c68ada723bfebf6d6197c1a20a23821ab4.

usages.context: Original city asset created for this library. No external deployment or reuse claimed.
